search_window.basis: Verified preceding heartbeat on ops/watch-ledger, then bounded recall; discovery date distinguished from publication and event dates; older reports checked for deduplication.

findings.title: Palestinian killed by Israeli gunfire in Jabalia north of Gaza
findings.affected_population_system: One Palestinian reportedly killed by Israeli gunfire; civilian status and identity not independently verified
findings.exact_supporting_passage: A Palestinian was killed on Sunday evening by Israeli occupation forces' gunfire in Jabalia, north of the Gaza Strip.
findings.summary: WAFA's 19:27 Gaza-local report identifies a 22 November Jabalia fatality not included as a location-specific finding in the latest ledger. A 21 November Jabalia fatality was already ledgered and must not be conflated. WAFA also repeats the previously logged Deir al-Balah death, which is excluded.

bounded_discovery_context.novelty_scope: Newly recovered 22 November location-specific death; publication occurred about 20 minutes before prior watch closed, but prior ledger did not report it.
bounded_discovery_context.duplicate_handling: Not added to health ministry cumulative totals; possible relation to separately reported Jabalia wounded group remains unconfirmed; distinct from 21 Nov Jabalia death.

findings.title: Israeli attacks kill 3 Gazans, injure 4 in latest ceasefire violation
findings.location: Bir al-Naaja, west of Jabalia, northern Gaza Strip
findings.affected_population_system: Three people reportedly wounded by an Israeli drone strike, one seriously; civilian group
findings.exact_supporting_passage: In northern Gaza, an Israeli drone struck a group of civilians in Bir al-Naaja, west of Jabalia, injuring three people, one of them seriously.
findings.summary: Anadolu's 22 November article provides a location-specific account of three people injured in a drone strike west of Jabalia, including one serious injury. The same article's Deir al-Balah fatality, Khan Younis child injury, and prior al-Mawasi deaths were already recorded and are excluded.

bounded_discovery_context.novelty_scope: Newly recovered specific injury incident; exact publication clock time unavailable.
bounded_discovery_context.duplicate_handling: Do not add article's aggregate three deaths/four injuries to prior totals; unknown whether the reported Jabalia wounded group overlaps WAFA's 22 November Jabalia fatality event.

findings.title: Children in besieged Gaza struggle to find life-saving insulin for diabetes
findings.location: Gaza City and Jabalia, Gaza Strip
findings.affected_population_system: Children with type 1 diabetes; access to insulin, blood-glucose monitoring strips, cold-chain storage, and emergency hospital care
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Janna was recently admitted to hospital for eight days, malnourished and dehydrated
findings.summary: New 22 November firsthand reporting documents families struggling to secure insulin and glucose testing strips; it describes one child's ICU admission during the prior week and another child's eight-day hospitalization, with a local diabetes organization reporting that it represents about 800 children. This adds specific patient-level effects to previously established medicine shortages; no newly verified systemwide stock total or event-hour timing.

bounded_discovery_context.novelty_scope: Newly surfaced detailed patient-impact reporting, not a newly established onset of insulin scarcity.
bounded_discovery_context.duplicate_handling: Contextual follow-up to OCHA's pre-existing shortage reports; no hospital admissions added to daily casualty statistics.

coverage_notes.purpose: Supplementary recall only; primary Gaza daily collector and publisher remain authoritative.
